nature_zh: 核心主张的盲文转写（英文 UEB 一级/逐字母）。转写规则为确定性字母映射（映射表随文可核），适合点显器与点字打印机输出。诚实边界：本转写未经盲文使用者或持证盲文校对员校对；中文现行盲文（声韵调方案）的机器转写错误风险高，本包不以机器转写充数——中文盲文版登记为待专业协作项，与包内「易读版与手语版须由相应使用者群体参与后发布」同一纪律。
nature_en: A braille transcription of the core proposition (English UEB Grade 1, letter-by-letter). The rule is a deterministic letter map (table included, checkable), suitable for refreshable displays and embossers. Honest boundary: this transcription has not been proofread by a braille user or certified transcriber; machine transcription of current Chinese braille (an initial-final-tone system) carries high error risk, so this package does not pad with one — the Chinese braille edition is registered as pending professional collaboration, under the same discipline as the easy-read and sign-language editions.
source_sentence: AI on equals AI off. Every service must stay usable when AI is off.
mapping_note_zh: 映射：小写字母按 UEB 一级字母表；大写前置大写指示符 ⠠；句点 ⠲；空格 ⠀。全句仅用字母、空格与句点，不涉及缩写、数字或符号规则，转写因此可逐字符核对。
chinese_edition_status_zh: 待专业协作：现行盲文转写须由盲文专业者完成并校对后随后续版本发布；本包如实登记缺项而非机器充数
